sanskrit_verse:
विद्यमानेऽपि लिखिते जीवत्स्वपि हि साक्षिषु।
विशेषतः स्थावराणां यन्न भुक्तं न तत्स्थिरम्॥
transliteration: vidyamāne 'pi likhite jīvatsv api hi sākṣiṣu | viśeṣataḥ sthāvarāṇāṃ yan na bhuktaṃ na tat sthiram ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Even when documented and witnessed by living beings, that which has not been fully experienced or realized by sentient entities—especially those rooted in stability—is not permanently established.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from experiential realization, not mere documentation.
Causation requires conscious participation for legal validity.
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by the ability to experience and integrate truth.
Restoration logic depends on the completion of existential integration.
executable_legal_axioms: IF a claim exists in writing BUT lacks experiential confirmation by a conscious entity, THEN it is legally unstable.
IF a being classified as sthavara (stable/rooted) has not enacted full experiential ownership of a right, THEN that right is nullified until conscious embodiment occurs.
IF testimony is provided solely by inactive witnesses without lived resonance, THEN reject as invalid pramana.
IF a legal state-change is declared but un-lived, THEN initiate automatic dissolution protocol.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that no ruling or law retains authority unless it is consciously embodied by those it governs. Witnessing alone does not confer legitimacy; only lived realization within stable consciousness creates enduring jurisprudence.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa must include both cognitive recognition and existential embodiment. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals that un-lived truths naturally decay. Therefore, non-enacted laws are inherently void, not due to fault, but due to incompleteness. This aligns justice with natural dharma rather than punitive enforcement.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Completion Process: Require conscious enactment of claimed rights before reintegration into legal standing.
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Guide individuals to embody their lawful entitlements through direct experience.
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Facilitate conditions where beings can stabilize and actualize latent legal realities.
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Realign dormant claims with active consciousness until stabilized through usage.
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed. Documentation without embodiment holds no permanence. Only what is consciously lived becomes eternally valid. Justice flows from awareness, not from record. Dharma is restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness is the ultimate judge.
